page.overview:
Who is Orran Durai?

Orran Durai, also known as Olan Durai, is a tertiary character and guest character from Final Fantasy Tactics. He is adopted son of Count Cidolfus Orlandeau and his right hand man in the Order of the Southern Sky, where he serves as a mage. A astrologer, Orran dedicates himself to spreading his knowledge to the people of Ivalice in order to show them the truth about the world.

Orran's biological father was a comrade of the order's lord commander, Count Orlandeau, but died in battle towards the end of the Fifty Years' War. Orran them was accepted into House Orlandeau at a young age, and the count later sent him to be adopted by Baron Durai, his trusted retainer. As Orlandeau has trueborn sons of his own, it would not be possible for Orran to inherit the title of count. However, allowing him to join House Durai showed how loving and devoted Count Orlandeau was to Orran.

Once he began serving under Count Orlandeau, Orran demonstrated a talent for gathering information, and his ability to formulate viable strategies based on his findings quickly earned him a place alongside his father as his right hand man.

In chapter 2, "The Manipulative & the Subservient", Orran was with his father, Cidolfus Orlandeau, when Delita Heiral brought Princess Ovelia to Duke Druksmald Goltanna. Delita also brought a prisoner who identified Chancellor Glevanne as the one behind the attempts on Ovelia's life. This sparked the War of the Lions.
